description: Compare current prices for one fuel type across 2-10 countries. Returns sorted table cheapest-first. Use it when someone asks which of two or more named countries has cheaper or more expensive fuel.

country_codes.description: Array of 2-10 ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to compare.

fuel_type.description: Fuel type to compare. e.g. gasoline, diesel, lpg, cng, e85.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

name: compare_fuel_prices
title: Compare Fuel Prices
